name: Enable Storage Sense
description: Turns on automatic cleanup with Windows Storage Sense to free up disk space by removing temporary files.

description_i18n.en: Turns on automatic cleanup with Windows Storage Sense to free up disk space by removing temporary files.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert die automatische Bereinigung mit Windows Storage Sense, um Speicherplatz durch das Entfernen von temporären Dateien freizugeben.
description_i18n.fr: Active la suppression automatique avec Stockage Sens pour libérer de l'espace disque en supprimant les fichiers temporaires.

warnings.title: Temporary data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary files may be removed. Windows will rebuild them as needed over time

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry at HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\StorageSense\Parameters\StoragePolicy to set value '01' to 1
compact_description: Turns on automatic cleanup with Windows Storage Sense.
